messages:
maya: Quick sync — we have TidalShift lined up for a short customer spotlight. Interview is Wed 3pm PT. Need: 1) a 2-3 sentence customer quote, 2) approval from legal, 3) one product metric (p99 latency drop), and 4) headshot and company logo.
emma: I’ve confirmed Wed 3pm with their PM (Jules). They asked for a 30-min slot and a short Q list beforehand. I can run the interview.
sam: I can draft the quote and pull the metric. Do we want an explicit number or just a percent improvement?
maya: Prefer explicit if they’re fine with it — makes the case study stronger. e.g., “reduced inference latency from 220ms to 90ms (59% reduction)”. But confirm with them + legal.
oliver: I can pull the p99/median numbers from the telemetry. Which timeframe should I use? last 30 days? last deploy?
emma: Ask them if the stat should be post-integration or post-optimizations. Jules said they rolled our optimizer two weeks ago, so last 14 days might be clean.
sam: Draft quote (first pass):
```
\"Redwood’s dedicated inference stack helped us cut tail latency dramatically, enabling real-time features for our users. The stability and predictable cost made it an easy choice.\" — Jules, TidalShift PM
```
Can someone check tone before I send to Jules?
maya: Love the tone. Maybe swap "dramatically" for "by 59%" if they approve numbers.
rebecca-legal: Quick legal note — if we include an exact metric and customer name we need a short approval from the customer on record plus a Legal quick-clauses check. I can run the clause check but we need the customer's signed approval (email is fine). Also watch for any competitive language.
emma: I’ll send the quote + metric back to Jules after we get your ok, @rebecca-legal. I’ll ask for approval via reply-all so we have the record.
assets-bot: Uploaded: interview-guide.pdf, hero-template.png, checklist.md (path: /marketing/case-studies/tidalshift/) :white_check_mark:
sam: Interview guide looks good. Adding one probing question about cost-per-token reduction and one about rollout experience.
maya: Great. After we get Jules’ signed approval, plan: 1) Publish micro-post + case study page, 2) draft webinar mention (if they want to co-present), 3) route inbound leads to Solutions (sam). Any objections?
oliver: No objections. I’ll attach the telemetry snapshot to the draft and redact any internal IDs.
rebecca-legal: Sounds fine. ETA: I can do clause quick-check by EOD tomorrow if you get the quote to me today.
emma: Sending the quote + numbers to Jules now. Will ping here when he replies.
maya: Awesome — if Jules says yes, @sam can you prepare the short customer-facing one-paragraph and a social post draft? Also create a simple CTA that routes inbound interest to sales@redwood.ai with tag "tidalshift-case".
sam: On it. Will have social draft + CTA text by tomorrow morning. :rocket:
emma: Jules replied — approved the quote and metric, attached screenshot of the signed email. Forwarding to @rebecca-legal now.
rebecca-legal: Got it, thanks. I completed the clause check — no issues. Approved for publish. Leaving a note: avoid customer internal roadmap references.
maya: Legal approved — woo! @assets-bot can you export hero image + headshot in publication sizes?
assets-bot: Exported: hero-1200x628.png, headshot-400x400.jpg, logo-srgb.svg. Uploaded to /marketing/case-studies/tidalshift/assets/ :sparkles:
sam: Final social draft:
"TidalShift cut inference p99 by 59% after moving to Redwood Dedicated, unlocking real-time experiences for customers. Read their story -> <link>"
Any edits?
oliver: Maybe add a short stat in parentheses after the headline. Otherwise looks good.
maya: OK — finalize and schedule next Tue. Sam, also draft inbound routing rule for HubSpot: if interest tag contains 'tidalshift-case' then assign to Solutions queue and add case-study lead tag.
sam: Will do. Posting draft in #marketing-assets channel once scheduled.
emma: Thanks everyone. Team ready to ship once assets go live. :tada:
